description: Many contacts, one or more tags: add tags to up to 500 existing subscribers in one call, identified by emails, externalIds, or subscriberIds. Never creates contacts. Built for reconciling historical or derived tags: subscribers that do not exist are reported in notFound instead of being created, and tag automations do NOT run unless triggerAutomations is true. Needs the subscribers:tag scope; a tag name that does not exist yet also needs tags:write. The agent_safe key preset includes both. Use add_subscriber or update_subscriber for single-contact changes.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

emails.description: Subscriber emails to tag. Combine with externalIds/subscriberIds as needed; at least one identifier list is required.

tags.description: Tag names to add to every matched subscriber.

triggerAutomations.description: Whether tag_added sequences may enroll these contacts. Defaults to false, which is what backfills want. Requires the automations:trigger scope.

name: bulk_add_subscriber_tags

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `bulk_add_subscriber_tags` MCP tool.

failures.description: List of per-subscriber failure (up to 50) records returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.
Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

notFound.description: Identifiers that did not resolve, grouped as emails, externalIds, and subscriberIds. These subscribers were NOT created.

tags.description: Normalized tag names applied to every matched subscriber.

triggeredAutomations.description: Whether tag_added sequences were allowed to enroll these contacts.

unchanged.description: Subscribers that already carried every tag.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
